title: 小语言模型是否知道自己不知道什么？
summary: 研究探讨基于熵的置信度信号能否提升30亿参数以下小语言模型的准确性。发现token级熵在SLM中几乎失效（91%组合接近零），而语义熵可恢复有效置信信号。通过语义熵将不确定查询路由至更大专家模型，准确率最高提升50个百分点，跨家族路由平均提升22%。
summary_en: This paper explores whether entropy-based confidence signals can improve Small Language Models (SLMs) under 3B parameters on consumer hardware. It finds token-level entropy is effectively blind in SLMs (near zero in 91% of cases), while semantic entropy recovers a viable confidence signal. Routing uncertain queries to larger expert models via semantic entropy yields up to +50pp accuracy gains, with cross-family routing averaging +22.0% vs +6.8% for same-family.
